messages.subject: CTMM Workshop at ASM-IMC Meeting
parts:
Hi folks,

There will be a ctmm workshop at the 2023 American Society of Mammalogists-International Mammalogical Congress joint meeting in Anchorage, Alaska (https://imc13.com/). More details to come in the future, but we hope to see some of you there.

Jesse
